scope: Byte-preserved historical HAETAE verification evidence; not a verification of the current working tree.
selection: Final 290 primary logs and checked main-source snapshots, HAETAE input inventories and finalization records, and diagnostic files explicitly referenced by the migration manifest. Unrelated projects, manuscript assets and other failed probes are omitted.

historical_index.note: Original host-path spellings remain in the immutable historical records. This English portable index identifies them by SHA-256 of their UTF-8 bytes; source and result hashes are unchanged.
